title: CASH FLOWS FROM INVESTINg ACTIVITIES
columns:
Amendments to IFRS 7
Disclosures – Transfers of
Financial Assets

The amendments to IFRS 7 increase the disclosure requirements for transactions
involving transfers of financial assets. These amendments are intended to provide
greater transparency around risk exposures of transactions where a financial asset is
transferred but the transferor retains some level of continuing exposure in the asset
The application of the amendment had no effect on the company’s financial
statements as the company did not transfer any such financial assets during the year.
